top_signals.title: Former CEO Chapek Says Disney Erased Him From Company
top_signals.summary: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek says he has not been back to a Disney park since being fired in 2022 and is not emotionally ready to go. Chapek says he's been erased from the company and pushed out. He speaks on Bloomberg Businessweek. (Source: Bloomberg)
